n32e4eb98e4.headline: SE Asia Stocks-Tepid as Yellen speech awaited; Philippines falls nearly 1 pct
n32e4eb98e4.summary: Philippine stocks declined nearly 1 percent to a three-week low, led by JG Summit Holdings and Universal Robina Corp, while other Southeast Asian markets were mostly flat.
n32e4eb98e4.why: The Philippine stock market is a key regional equity market, and movements ahead of major Federal Reserve speeches reflect investor sensitivity to global monetary policy.
n32e4eb98e4.why_moved: Anticipation of Federal Reserve policy signals from Yellen caused investor caution, leading to a near 1% drop in Philippine equities.
